description: Hooks of this agent: aos functions run when an event happens (before_queue, after_queue, before_tool, after_tool, brain_failed, tool_added, after_start, after_stop, before_run, after_run, on_clock); the stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off. The timer hook is a place to hang something every 5 minutes (on_clock, every_ms 300000, AOS_CLOCK); its handler does nothing. The mail_notify hook looks at your mailbox every minute (on_clock, every_ms 60000) and, only when new letters came, puts one message "[aos] new_mail: N new letters from A, B. ..." in your queue (after a sleep, letters that came while you slept are announced once, those announced before are not; on a fresh start (no notified.json and no non-empty history.jsonl yet) waiting letters are only marked as known; a stack that already ran (has non-empty history) is treated like waking up: waiting letters are announced once); turn it off or change the interval in your stack copy (self_hook rm / add with replace). The brain_notify hook sends BLOCKED letters for BudgetMissing refusals and BrainFailed (once from the third consecutive retry, or when stopped) to the mailbox named by AOS_NOTIFY_BOX; subagent add sets it to the parent's mailbox unless explicitly given. The context_wrap hook sends /compact to this agent when measured context usage reaches 35%; wrap defaults to false for this body.
